main_measure.name: mean excess next-day return on case bars (close[t+1]/close[t]-1 minus coin mean daily return)

statistic.name: t of the mean, cases of one day summed

main_measure.threshold: mean above 0 with t >= 2 (and supporting check) confirms; below 0 with t <= -2 rejects; at least 30 case days

supporting_check.name: upper-half minus lower-half mean excess return, split at median forecast

reading: Cases are bars in regime mean_reversion with forecast > 0 and a next bar in the same window; the t uses per-day sums of the excess returns over the case days; the median split puts forecasts above the median in the upper half and at or below it in the lower half (>= vs < if the upper half would be empty).
